positive_snippets: I am from Mumbai and i am recently visited to this hotel my experience was so good and staff & manager was very friendly and fruitful in nature..Thank you for Best service🙏
negative_snippets: Real name is Hotel Green Snapper. Prices are around 1500 for 1 room. Most rooms dont have any working AC so check before booking. Staff is lazy, had to keep asking again and again to fix AC, change rooms or clean the rooms, bathrooms as everything looked dirty. Beds are good but bedsheets dont look clean either, they maybe reuse the same bedsheets many times and then wash. No mug or bucket in bathroom either you can only shower. Would recommend if youre desperate and need a place to sleep.
